units.source_text: 常陆守为了款待新女婿左近少将，忙得不亦乐乎。

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi was beside himself with busyness as he prepared to entertain his new son-in-law, the Sakon Lesser Captain.

units.source_text: 他埋怨夫人，说她不肯和他同心协力，有损体面。

en.t: He complained about his wife, saying that her refusal to cooperate with him was damaging their dignity.

units.source_text: 夫人气得很，她想：“都是此人不好，惹起这许多纠纷。”

en.t: His wife was furious and thought, "This is all his fault; he is the one who stirred up all this trouble."

units.source_text: 她所最疼爱的女儿为此而遭受苦患，使她痛心疾首，因此全不把这女婿看在眼里。

en.t: Because her most beloved daughter had suffered so much over this, she was heartbroken and could not bring herself to think anything of this son-in-law.

units.source_text: 她回想前几天看见这少将在匂亲王面前，形容猥琐得不像一个人，因此十分看不起他，奉他为东床娇客的念头早已打消。

en.t: She remembered seeing this Lesser Captain a few days earlier before Prince Niou, looking so shabby and contemptible that he hardly seemed human, and so she despised him and had long since given up any thought of welcoming him as an honored son-in-law.

units.source_text: 但她想：“不知他在这里怎样，我还没有看见过他日常晏居时的模样呢。”

en.t: Still, she thought, "I wonder what he is like here. I have not yet seen how he looks when he is at ease in everyday life."

units.source_text: 就在有一天昼间，当少将闲居在家之时，走到他的房间旁边，向隙缝中窥探。

en.t: So one day in the daytime, when the Lesser Captain was relaxing at home, she went beside his room and peered in through a crack.

units.source_text: 但见他身穿柔软的白绫上衣，内衬鲜艳的砑光淡红梅色衫子，正坐在窗前欣赏庭中花木。

en.t: She saw him wearing a soft white damask robe over a glossy, vivid pale red-plum underrobe, sitting by the window and admiring the flowers and trees in the garden.

units.source_text: 她觉得此人姿态也还清秀，并无拙劣之相。

en.t: She felt that his bearing was actually quite refined and showed no sign of awkward ugliness.

units.source_text: 那女儿还很稚气，无心无思地靠在一旁。

en.t: The daughter, still very childish, leaned nearby without a care or thought.

units.source_text: 她回想匂亲王和二女公子并坐时的模样，觉得这一对夫妻毕竟逊色得多。

en.t: When she recalled the sight of Prince Niou sitting beside the second young lady, she felt that this married pair was, after all, far inferior.

units.source_text: 少将和身边几个侍女谈笑戏耍起来。

en.t: The Lesser Captain began chatting, laughing, and joking with several serving women near him.

units.source_text: 夫人细看他那随意不拘的姿态，觉得不像以前在二条院看到时那样丑陋不堪入目。

en.t: As the wife looked closely at his relaxed and unrestrained manner, she felt that he was not as unbearably ugly as he had seemed when she saw him before at Nijo-in.

units.source_text: 她疑心那天看到的是另外一个少将。

en.t: She even wondered whether the Lesser Captain she had seen that day had been someone else.

units.source_text: 正在此时，忽闻少将说道：“兵部卿亲王家里的萩花真是特别好看！

en.t: Just then she suddenly heard the Lesser Captain say, "The bush clover at the Prince of Hyobukyo's residence is truly exceptionally beautiful!

units.source_text: 不知是哪里来的种子。

en.t: I wonder where the seeds came from.

units.source_text: 同是花枝，他家的格外艳丽。

en.t: Though they are the same flowering branches, the ones at his house are especially splendid.

units.source_text: 前天我到他家，想折取一枝。

en.t: The day before yesterday I went to his house and wanted to break off a branch.

units.source_text: 但亲王正好要出门，我终于不曾折得。

en.t: But the prince was just about to go out, so in the end I never managed to take one.

units.source_text: 那时他还吟唱着‘褪色萩花犹堪惜’之歌。

en.t: At that time he was also chanting a poem about how even faded bush clover is still worth cherishing.

units.source_text: 我真想叫年轻的女子看看他那时的丰采呢！”

en.t: I truly wished I could have shown the young women how splendid he looked then!"

units.source_text: 说罢，他自己也吟唱些诗歌。

en.t: After saying this, he himself began chanting a few poems.

units.source_text: 夫人在心中讥诮他：“算了吧！

en.t: The wife mocked him inwardly, thinking, "Enough of that!

units.source_text: 我想想此人品性之卑鄙，觉得不像个人；看看他在匂亲王面前时的丑陋，实在令人难堪。

en.t: When I think of how base his character is, he hardly seems human; and when I remember his ugliness before Prince Niou, it was truly unbearable to look at.

units.source_text: 不知他在吟唱什么诗歌。”

en.t: Who knows what sort of poems he is chanting."

units.source_text: 然而看他此时模样，毕竟不是全不知趣的人。

en.t: Yet seeing how he looked at this moment, she had to admit that he was not entirely without taste.

units.source_text: 她想试试他的才能，便命侍女传言，赠以诗曰：

en.t: Wanting to test his talent, she had a serving woman carry a message and sent him this poem:
